jobPosting.title: Staff Platform Engineer
jobPosting.descriptionHtml:
About Us

Linear Scale builds high-reliability cloud deployment pipelines for enterprise teams.

Responsibilities

  • Own developer productivity tooling and CI/CD pipelines.
  • Improve deployment velocity from 20 minutes to under 3 minutes.

What We're Looking For

  • 7+ years of experience in platform engineering or SRE.
  • Deep experience with Docker, Kubernetes, and Terraform.
  • AWS Certified Solutions Architect certification or equivalent experience.

Bonus Qualifications

  • Experience with Rust or WebAssembly compilation pipelines.

Compensation

Target salary is $215,000 - $250,000 USD plus equity.
